title: Leonxlnx Taste Skill: portable anti-slop agent skills for UI layout and motion
summary: MIT-licensed agent-skills repo that upgrades AI-built interfaces on layout, typography, motion, and spacing, plus image-generation skills for reference boards. Individual SKILL.md files install in Codex, Cursor, or Claude Code; docs and examples live at tasteskill.dev.
question_it_answers: Which portable taste skills upgrade generic AI-built UIs instead of adding another component kit?

claims.text: The repo ships portable Agent Skills that improve layout, typography, motion, and spacing on AI-built interfaces.
claims.evidence: Portable Agent Skills that upgrade AI-built interfaces: stronger layout, typography, motion, and spacing instead of boilerplate-looking UIs.
claims.subject: design-agent-skills

claims.text: Image-generation skills produce reference boards meant to hand off mood and direction to coding agents.
claims.evidence: Also includes image-generation skills for reference boards to hand off to coding agents.
claims.subject: design-agent-skills
